body.x: Amo Lab will be working withKyungpook National University Smart Venture Campus for 4 days from January 8(Tue) to January 11 (Fri) 2019 at MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT & MIK NIGHT'(BOOTH # 52843) in CES 2019 EUREKA PARK, the world's largest technologyexhibition in Las Vegas, to show wearable sleep improvement device 'AMO+.'
'Sleep' is one of the basicphysiology of humans, and everyone knows its importance. However, modern peoplewho are tired of time and stressed cannot sleep enough and suffer from sleepdisorders.

Amo Lab's "AMO+"wearable sleep enhancement device can solve this problem. AMO + activatesparasympathetic nerves to quickly restore the balance of the autonomic nervoussystem, improve sleep quality by reducing stress, stabilizing heart rate andrespiration.

In addition, the device is anon-contact bioelectronic medicine that not only restores sleep but also helpschronic diseases associated with aging, while restoring health. "A finalgoal of Amo Lab is to research and develop technologies that can significantlyextend human life span." Amo Lab official said.

Amo Lab will launch its productsin the global market in early 2019. Currently, Taiwan and Japan distributorshave been confirmed, and meetings on sales or collaboration with many globaldistribution channels such as Johnson & Johnson (Sweden), OURA (Finland),P&G (Belgium), Ogawa Group (China), LG U+ is progressing. We expect thefirst sales in Europe and Southeast Asia in mid-2019.

On the other hand, MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT, which isa global project zone which is formed as part of a project to help Korea'sstart-up into the global market, is attracting attention with variousactivities such as exhibition, pitching and party.
